evidence.reason: `record_legacy_success` still deletes both failure counters whenever the family is not currently quarantined. A released family has release floor records but its `quarantined` flags are no longer set, so a counted success can erase the counters that `legacy_retry_view` later checks against the stored release floors, producing the reported false denial. Skipping deletion for families present in `legacy_coverage_releases` is the minimal compatible fix.
